Subject: Post-demo recap + request: who owns procurement & security?

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. I wanted to capture the quick next steps and a single ask from our side so we can line up the right folks and keep momentum. High-level recap below: 

- Business need: low-latency inference for clinical summarization across 3 regional sites; priority is predictable SLOs and data isolation for PHI workflows.
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: (1) SLA for 99th pct latency, (2) on-prem + VPC support, (3) audit log retention & key management controls.
- Our fit: Redwood Dedicated + Private (VPC) can meet the isolation + SLO targets; we have explicit KMS/HSM integrations and per-token cost controls.

Single ask: can you share the procurement owner + security/compliance lead (name/email) who should get the technical evidence pack? If you prefer, an org snapshot (even a one-page chart) would be perfect. We want to avoid sending to the wrong mailbox and slowing your cycle.

Attached: the demo deck and a short evidence matrix that maps the controls we discussed.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You share owners (procurement + security) — we’ll send evidence & a tailored SOW template.
2) If helpful, Karthik (SE) can join a 30-min tech Q&A with your security team.
3) Marissa will draft an initial pricing sketch once we know procurement cadence.

Thanks — happy to handle intros to legal if that helps.

Rachel

Redwood Inference

Thanks Rachel — great walkthrough. Quick answers: 

- Procurement owner: Jenna Alvarez (procurement@novamed.com) — she handles contracts and standard SOWs.
- Security/compliance: Darren Hughes (darren.hughes@novamed.com) — he owns IR, data residency decisions, and third-party risk.

Darren has asked for a short packet with: SOC2 scope, data residency options, KMS/HSM integrations, and your proposed audit-log retention. Can Karthik put that together? Also, Jenna prefers to see an initial term sheet / indicative pricing sheet before we escalate to legal.

I can intro both folks on a single thread if you want me to. We’d also like to understand any onboarding timelines for a private VPC deployment (rough weeks + required access).

—Sam

Hi all — Jenna here from procurement. Thanks for the context. A few quick notes from procurement-side preferences: 

- Please send an indicative pricing sheet + proposed standard SOW (term length, renewal cadence, and termination rights).
- We need to understand any data residency guarantees and the model variants that will be in scope for the contract (e.g., dedicated GPU pool vs shared hosted).
- Our standard timeline for vendor review is 2–3 weeks once legal gets the SOW; if there are any non-standard terms (indemnities, data escrow, or special termination rights) flag them up front.

Samantha — I don’t need the SOC2 right away, just the high-level cert + whether you can provide a redacted report under an NDA. If Redwood requires a standard mutual NDA, please send your template.

Rachel/Marissa — can you drop the pricing sketch and a one-page onboarding timeline? That will help Jenna triage. Also copying Darren to ensure security constraints are captured.
